messages:
Alex Kim: heads up — CI on PR #3427 failing on linux CI (ubuntu-20). test failing: tests/eval/test_reranker.py::test_consistency. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3427
Priya Desai: ugh, that test has been flaky before. can you paste the failing log?
Alex Kim: here's the relevant snippet:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 0.89 +/- 0.01 != 0.87
.../tests/eval/test_reranker.py:54: AssertionError
```
Sam Turner: looks like noise — could be random float seed. Did the job run on GPU vs CPU?
Alex Kim: job ran on ubuntu-20, runner: self-hosted-gpu-2. commit 9f3a7bd
Maria Lopez: @Sam @Priya if it's seed related we should either make test tolerant or fix RNG. don't want snapshot update unless we know root cause :eyes:
Priya Desai: agree. @Alex can you re-run the job with `CI_RERUN=1`? sometimes second run passes
Alex Kim: re-run triggered: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/3427/9 — kicked by @alex
CI Bot: Job 3427 #9 started on runner self-hosted-gpu-2. Command: `pytest tests/eval/test_reranker.py::test_consistency -q`
CI Bot: Job 3427 #9 finished — FAILURE (exit code 1)
Sam Turner: still failing. can you upload full test output? maybe a previous change in model outputs changed ranking
Alex Kim: uploaded logs: https://internal.redwood.ai/artifacts/3427/9/log.txt
Maria Lopez: quick grep shows model_score average dropped from 0.89 to 0.87 after pr change in `reranker.py` (line 128). @Alex did your PR touch that file?
Alex Kim: no, PR touches batching and caching only. but the change affects tokenization order which could change scores
Priya Desai: if nondeterministic, add `pytest.mark.flaky` with 3 reruns temporarily while we root cause? we prefer to avoid that for core evals
Sam Turner: alternative — pin RNG with `np.random.seed(42)` in test setup and assert deterministic output. If that passes we can dedup flaky behavior
Alex Kim: added a quick commit to pin seed: 9f3a7bd -> 9f3a7bd2 (pushed)
CI Bot: New commit 9f3a7bd2 pushed to PR #3427
CI Bot: Job 3427 #10 started
CI Bot: Job 3427 #10 finished — PASSED :tada:
Priya Desai: nice. Can someone review and approve? I can give a quick pass if nobody else
Maria Lopez: requesting review from @Sam for changes touching `reranker.py`
Sam Turner: on it, will look today. if green and minor, we can merge after 1 approval
Alex Kim: thanks all. will hold on snapshot updates. I'll follow up with a proper fix to avoid seed pin in master
Priya Desai: also open an issue to track flaky eval tests and add to test-backlog
Alex Kim: created issue #298: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/issues/298
Maria Lopez: :thumbsup:
Sam Turner: approving now — LGTM
Alex Kim: merging after CI flake check passes for 2 consecutive runs
CI Bot: Merge queued for PR #3427 — awaiting required checks
CI Bot: Merge completed — PR #3427 merged by Alex Kim
Alex Kim: thanks team!
